oneLiner: Turns messy status bullets into two polished updates—one for execs, one for the team.
problem: People writing status updates either send the same raw, jargon-heavy bullets to everyone or waste time manually rewriting the same update twice for different audiences with different needs for detail and tone.
targetUser: Project managers, team leads, and individual contributors who regularly report progress to both leadership and their immediate team.
coreFlow: User pastes or types rough status bullets into a single input box
User optionally adds context (project name, audience notes, key highlights)
Tool generates two versions: a concise exec summary and a detailed team update
User reviews both versions side-by-side and edits inline as needed
User copies, exports, or downloads the finalized versions

screens.name: Input
screens.purpose: Capture rough bullets and optional context before generation

screens.name: Generating
screens.purpose: Show progress while the two versions are being created

screens.name: Dual Editor
screens.purpose: Display exec and team versions side-by-side for review and editing

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: Browse and reuse past status updates

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Adjust default tone, length, and export preferences

outOfScope: Direct send integrations with Slack, email, or Teams
Automated data pulls from Jira, Asana, or other PM tools
